# rsDiamondMesh · Diamond Mesh

> Module: Geometry / Meshes

[← Back to command index](/en/commands/)

**Function**: Two-color (diamond) topological mesh generated by Diamond / Ambo operator

![rsDiamondMesh input: original mesh (thick wireframe)](../../assets/rsDiamondMesh/image1.png)
*Original mesh (Before): Rhino 8 perspective viewport, the object consists of a square plate with a central depression (funnel-shaped) on the top and a cylinder on the bottom. The green*

![rsDiamondMesh output: diamond topological mesh generated by Diamond / Ambo operator (the wireframe is significantly denser)](../../assets/rsDiamondMesh/image2.png)
*Diamond topological mesh generated by the Diamond / Ambo operator (After): the same viewport and the same object (square plate + central funnel + lower cylinder) as in Example 1, the mesh line density increases significantly - the mesh lines on the square plate change from thick to thin, from sparse to dense, and the longitudinal lines on the cylinder surface are also significantly denser; no UI panel (no adjustable parameters), only the topological changes after the operator are displayed*

> Screenshots and videos may show a Chinese-language interface. Labels and control positions can vary by Rhino or RSTool version.

**Run**: Enter `rsDiamondMesh` in the Rhino command line (command-line interaction).

**Workflow**:

1. Select mesh
2. Generate Diamond (Ambo) rhombus topology mesh

**Parameters**:

> This command has no numeric command-line parameters. Adjust its options in the settings window.

**Notes**: No tunable parameters. The mesh generated by rsDiamondMesh is generally not stretched and even enough, and generally needs to be combined with [rsMeshRelax](/commands/rsMeshRelax) for secondary processing.
